tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma 'phrin las kyi mgon po kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi spyan 'dren bskang ba 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa phan bde kun 'byung bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī bānsaṅgu ru shtsā dhi de wa tā ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang bar 'dod pas/ gtor tshogs spyan gzigs ma tshang ba med pa bshams nas bdag bskyed dang mchod pa byin rlabs sogs rang gi phyag len ltar byas la/ sha chen tshil chen gyi gsur dud dang spos dkar sogs bsregs pa'i bsang dud che bar btang la/ mi rkang gi gling bu dang / rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra rgya cher bsgrags la chems brdung dang gsum brdeg lan bcas blangs nas gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad du/ hūm̐/ phan bde kun 'byung bstan pa rin po che/ /g.yel med srung ba'i chos skyong yid bzhin nor/ /mthu ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe thub pa'i dbang po rta mgrin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur dam tshig phog /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i chos skyong gnas 'dir byon/ /de rjes slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dbang bskur gsang ba'i mtshan gsol bsam yas sogs/ /bod yul gtsug lag khang gi srung ma ru/ /bka' bsgos bzhin du gnas 'dir da lta byon/ /phyi rab dus su chos rje bla ma dang / /sa skya lo tsā la sogs bstan 'dzin gyi/ /skyes chen mang pos 'phrin las mgon po ru/ /mnga' gsol zhal bzhes dran pas da byon cig /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sprul pa'i skyes chen sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/

/ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /bstan pa'i nyams gso mtha' dag mthar phyin tshe/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin po che/ /bsrung zhing skyong ba'i gnyer gtad bka' bsgos shing / /zhal bzhes ji bzhin ma thogs myur du byon/ /des na dang por bcom ldan rta mgrin bka'/ /de rjes slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bka'/ /de nas 'khon ston rim par byon pa'i bkas/ /ji ltar bsgos shing 'phrin las bcol ba ltar/ /da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis nyer bskul gyis/ /bstan pa 'jig la thug pa'i dus 'di la/ /thugs rje mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed nas/ /skad cig nyid la yud kyis gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg dang / chems brdung gi rjes su che ba gnyis gdab la bzhag de nas 'dur gdangs dang bcas 'di skad du/ hūm̐/ ka ba keng rus mi mgo'i rtsig pa can/ /kha bad lcang los byas pa'i drag po'i gnas/ /ga pur spos dkar bsur dud sprin ltar gtibs/ /nga yi srung ma gnas 'dir gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes brjod la sngar bzhin rol mo gsum brdeg dang / chems brdung che ba nyis brdeg pa sogs byas la/ de nas dbyangs gdangs sogs yod med long skabs dang sbyar la/ 'di skad du/ hūm̐/ ca re bshams pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / /cha lang rnga dang rkang gling rol mo'i sgra/ /ja chang sha khrag bza' btung sna tshogs pas/ /nya phyis la sogs snod bzang bkang ste 'bul/ /ta la'i ljon 'dra'i yid 'phrog mchod pa'i rdzas/ /tha mal blo 'das zhing khams kun gang bar/ /da lta blo yis sprul te srid mtha'i bar/ /na rgas skye 'chi spangs pa khyod la 'bul/ /pa re pu re'i chags sdang blo ngan 'dis/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma'i thugs 'gal ba/ /ba glang lta bu bdag 'dra'i 'gyod pas bshags/ /ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /tsa tur las kyi mdangs ldan dar zab dang /

/tsha grang gdung skyob srog chags pags pa'i tshogs/ /dza re rakta 'dzag pa'i mgo 'phreng dang / /wa dang spyang ki rta g.yag bya nag tshogs/ /zha nye ma 'dres dngul sogs rin chen dang / /za ma bcud ldan tshogs 'khor ri ltar spungs/ /'a 'ur snyan brjid dbyangs kyi nga ro dang / /ya rabs dgyes pa'i yo byad bsam mi khyab/ /ra hū la sogs las mkhan rngam pa'i tshogs/ /la si seng sogs gos bzang tshar du dngar/ /sha khrag rus pa'i dmar gtor ri rab tsam/ /sa gzhi ri klung bkang 'dra'i mthun rdzas 'di/ /ha ha'i bzhad sgra sgrog pa khyod la 'bul/ /a yig don ldan chos kyi gnas lugs mchog /bla ma yi dam chos skyong rang sems rnams/ /dbyer med shes pa'i lta bas rgyas btab pa'i/ /snang ba 'gag med lhag bsam dmigs pa'i 'phrul/ /bstan srung kun tu dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po dang / /da bcol legs pa'i gsal 'debs chen por 'bul/ /dgyes pas bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /da dung bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu'i tshogs/ /rigs dang chos las skyes pa mang 'phel nas/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan 'di cher rgyas mdzod/ /kha ba ri 'di'i rgyal po rgyal phran dang / /'bangs rnams 'khor bcas de yi lha srung kun/ /bdag cag brgyud par bcas pa'i dbang 'dus nas/ /ljongs 'di sa skya'i bstan pas khyab par mdzod/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rjer ldan pa yi/ /bstan pa 'dzin nus gang zag thams cad kyang / /'khrul zad gong ma'i bzhed gzhung snod gyur te/ /de rgyun dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ /dad pa dman zhing dge ba'i blo gros dman/ /chos la 'jug pa'i skal ba chung rnams kyang / /bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchod la spro ba'i blos/ /kun kyang dkar po'i las la 'jug par mdzod/ /bdag cag rnams la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams/ /mthu ldan rnams kyis lo zla ma 'gyangs par/

/chos dbyings bsgral te gnod pas mi tshugs mdzod/ /ding sang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni/ /'bab chu zad pa'i rdzing bzhin nyin rer 'bri/ /'di 'dra bka' srung rnams kyis ma gzigs sam/ /log sgrub mtha' dag myur du tshar gcod mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag bcas/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ /slar yang sprul pas bstan pa rgyas byed mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu'i mthu rtsal gyis/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rol mo gsum brdeg dang / chems brdung gi bar la rang gang 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol la/ de nas gsum brdeg lan bcas byas bzhag ste/ rjes chog bkra shis sogs spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /zhes dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma 'phrin las kyi mgon po kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi spyan 'dren bskang ba 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa phan bde kun 'byung bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa zhes bya ba shlau ka nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lcags mo yos kyi bkra shis kyi lo gsar du tshes pa'i zla ba dang po'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar chos skyong chen po'i bkas bskul ma byung ba bzhin myur ba sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs rus cho 'brangs phun sum tshogs shing lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs mnga' ba mtsho sgo ba mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje'i phyag sor gyi 'du byed las bskrun pa'o/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/shu bha mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ kalya na wardhantu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ dpal bsam yas kyi srung ma kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi spyan 'dren 'phrin bcol gyi tshigs bcad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
